title: SEND_KEYS_SETTLE_MS = 50 is still an unexplained magnitude (carried forward fro…
body: SEND_KEYS_SETTLE_MS = 50 is still an unexplained magnitude (carried forward from round 1). The JSDoc justifies why a settle window exists but not why 50 ms is the right size for one tmux refresh cycle. A one-line note on how the value was chosen (measured, or a deliberate conservative floor) would make a future tuning change safe.

title: Blocking-window consequence worth a follow-up issue, not a deviation from the P…
body: Blocking-window consequence worth a follow-up issue, not a deviation from the PRD (which mandated the raise): the default sleepFn is Bun.sleepSync, so 5s -> 30s makes every push against a busy orchestrator block the calling thread up to 30s. None of the 5 production call sites (src/commands/issue.ts:185, src/commands/review.ts:183, src/commands/spec.ts:218, src/commands/orch-recycle-watch.ts:417, src/supervisor/host.ts:330) passes an idleTimeoutMs override, so all inherit the 30s ceiling; host.ts:330 is reached from the sidecar merge-watch/narration path, so the sidecar outer loop can now stall 6x longer per narration. Same class as the known CAM-103 outer-loop-blocking concern. Consider an async settle/poll path or a shorter per-caller budget for best-effort narration pushes.
